claim_boundary: Longitudinal wristband sleep measurements from professional fencing-athlete study codes. The supplement has 2,607 rows and 25 codes, while the article states 2,459 valid days from 23 athletes; the raw file also dates observations in 2022 although the methods text says 2023. No unpublished inclusion rule is reconstructed, no code is assumed to be a particular weapon, and duplicates and date collisions are flagged rather than silently removed.
